purpose: Shift educational attention without alarmism. Raises visibility of calm guidance topics — never auto-starts scanners, never opens attack tools.
philosophy: Amplify understanding and hygiene, not urgency theater

attentionLevels.label: Background
attentionLevels.meaning: Logged for completeness; no surface promote.

attentionLevels.label: Act calmly
attentionLevels.meaning: Suggest a safe educational action (update, backup check, retune receiver).

attentionLevels.label: Monitor
attentionLevels.meaning: Watch window is open; continue logging — not 'hunt'.

focusAreas.label: Browser-related visibility
focusAreas.exampleTrigger: Major browser zero-days or high-severity browser advisories (cited).

focusAreas.label: Navigation reliability
focusAreas.exampleTrigger: Reports of GPS interference or GNSS degradation.

focusAreas.label: Radio impacts
focusAreas.exampleTrigger: Severe space weather or unusual HF/VHF conditions.
calmActions: Link Outdoor Intelligence / space-weather context when available

focusAreas.label: Connectivity awareness
focusAreas.exampleTrigger: ISP, DNS, CDN, or cloud status disruptions.

focusAreas.label: Legal listening reminders
calmActions: Decline guidance that violates local law

rulesOfTone: No red flashing SOC aesthetics for educational digests
Pair every elevated severity with calmGuidance
Conflicting sources lower confidence and attention, they do not raise drama
Resolved events lower focus area weights
